x: One small local model answers every Gemini model id (llama.cpp on the appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the page registers one), so quality is toy-grade; with no model running the API returns 503 UNAVAILABLE rather than an answer. Text parts only: no images/audio/video, tools/function calling, grounding, safety settings or tuning.

Embeddings come from the local embedding model when the backend has one; otherwise from vyomi-hash-embed, a deterministic bag-of-words embedding that is stable and cosine-comparable but not semantic. Dimensions are 256, not the real models' 768/3072.
